summary.summary: The speaker contrasts the stock market's short-term behavior as a speculative voting machine with its long-term function as an accurate weighing machine that reveals true value.

topics.title: Short-Term vs. Long-Term Market Behavior
topics.description: S01 argues that the short-term stock market acts as a voting machine driven by speculative interests and supply and demand, whereas the long-term market acts as a weighing machine that accurately reveals an asset's true worth, allowing investors who understand this value to take advantage of the market.

details.title: The Voting Machine vs. Weighing Machine Metaphor
details.description: S01 outlines the distinction between short-term speculative pricing and long-term value assessment as the core message of the book.
